subject: Security exhibit: audit rights, pen-test language & evidence cadence (Medivance)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medivance.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit: audit rights, pen-test language & evidence cadence (Medivance)

Hi Elena,

Following our contract sync last week, attaching a first pass at a Security Exhibit for the MSA / Order Form. High-level goals here are: preserve Medivance's need for reasonable assurance (SOC 2 + pen-test posture) while keeping operating constraints for Redwood (staging-only tests, scoped evidence extracts, limited inspection windows).

Ask-list and proposed defaults (summary):
- SOC 2: Redwood will provide latest SOC 2 Type II report annually; we propose a quarterly attestation summary for critical controls.
- Pen-test: vendor-initiated pen-tests allowed against a staging replica only; 30 days advance notice; timeboxed to a 72-hour window unless mutually agreed.
- Inspection / audit rights: "bounded inspection" language — access to sanitized artifacts and a limited inspection call; privileged inspection requires narrow scope + RBAC-approved accounts.
- Evidence cadence: weekly artifact snapshot (sanitized logs, control evidence pointers) delivered to a secure SFTP + point-of-contact for escalation.
- Redlines we expect from Legal: liability carveouts, non-production-only testing, and controls for data sanitization.

Attached: Redwood_Draft_Security_Exhibit_v1.docx 
Would like to get your marked-up redlines by EOD Monday 6/24 so we can run through legal/engineering impacts. If helpful we can do a 30-minute bridge Tuesday to walk specifics.

Thanks — appreciate the partnership here.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships (Contracting lead)
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Draft_Security_Exhibit_v1.docx (docx)
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medivance.com>

Cc: Medivance Legal <legal@medivance.com>, Tom Grant <tom.grant@medivance.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2028 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit: audit rights, pen-test language & evidence cadence (Medivance)

Karthik —

Thanks for the draft. I reviewed with our security and legal teams; attaching our redlines and a short comment doc. Key asks from our side:

1) Inspection scope — we can't accept a blanket "staging-only" carveout if it prevents us from verifying production isolation claims. We need explicit inspection rights for control verification, with a formal process for sensitive artifact handling.
2) Pen-test notice — 45 days notice is our baseline (we propose modifying your 30-day ask). We also need the option for a reactive emergency test if an incident indicates a production control break.
3) Evidence — request for retained pen-test reports (redacted), raw vulnerability scan outputs, and sample log extracts. We understand the need for sanitization but need proof of remediation and timeline.
4) Escrow/forensics access — a fallback clause if we reasonably suspect data exposure.

We can narrow language around RBAC/least privilege, but we won't agree to language that effectively prevents us from doing a meaningful assurance review. Proposal: quick call tomorrow 6/21 AM PT with Legal + InfoSec + Engineering to align scope and then produce a substitution redline set.

Attached: Medivance_Redlines_Security_Exhibit.docx (docx)

- Elena
Elena Rossi
Senior Counsel, Strategic Contracts
Medivance Health
attachments: Medivance_Redlines_Security_Exhibit.docx (docx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medivance.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2028 15:27:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit: audit rights, pen-test language & evidence cadence (Medivance)

Elena — thanks for the clear feedback and the redlines. I pulled together a short compromise proposal to move this forward without blocking the orderform. High-level response: 

- Inspection: propose a two-tier approach (1) regular assurance: sanitized artifact delivery + 60-minute control walkthrough call and (2) privileged inspection: allowed only with narrowly scoped, mutually agreed sampling and a legal NDA addendum. That lets you validate controls while protecting customer/user data.
- Pen-test timing: accept 45 days notice for vendor-initiated testing; Redwood requests a maximum continuous window of 96 hours and a limit of two full-scope tests per 12 months. Emergency testing permitted with joint incident triage and constrained blast radius.
- Evidence package: we can provide (a) latest SOC 2 report; (b) pen-test executive summary and remediation timeline; (c) sampled, sanitized log extracts for the test window; (d) infrastructure diagram with CPL (control point list). Full raw reports will be redacted and provided under an MSA addendum with an agreed data handling appendix.

Operational ask: our engineering team needs 48 hours to scope out what sanitized samples look like for the specific controls you want to verify. Suggested next steps:
1) 45-minute bridge Wed 6/21 10:00 AM PT (Karthik / Marcus / Laura / Elena / Medivance InfoSec).
2) Post-call: Redwood will upload a MutualActionPlan_Medivance_v1.pdf with timelines and a sample artifact checklist to the shared drive.
3) Legal to exchange a narrow inspection NDA addendum; if we can get an in-principle signoff by 6/28 we can close language in time for the orderform.

Attaching the MutualActionPlan_Medivance_v1.pdf with the proposed artifact checklist. Please confirm the bridge time or propose an alternative.

Thanks,
Karthik
attachments: MutualActionPlan_Medivance_v1.pdf (pdf)

Subject: Re: Security exhibit: audit rights, pen-test language & evidence cadence (Medivance)

Elena / team — quick operational note from engineering ahead of the bridge:

We accept the 45-day notice for vendor-initiated pen-tests and can support an emergency triage test process. To set expectations on artifacts and timing, Redwood will provide the following for an agreed test window: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) + a one-page control summary.
- Pen-test executive summary (redacted raw findings) and remediation tracker with target dates.
- Sampled, sanitized logs (UTC timestamps, application traces) covering the test window; logs will be scoped to the asserted systems and stripped of PII.
- Environment diagram and a list of in-scope endpoints.
- A named on-call engineer and SFTP access to a time-boxed folder for evidence transfer.

Operational guardrails we need in the exhibit: scope confined to non-prod, a 96-hour maximum continuous window, and explicit rollback/communication points for any test that risks wider impact. If Medivance needs any additional artifacts (e.g., specific DB query traces), please flag them on the call and we'll scope feasibility.

I put a short pen-test playbook in the attachments to give you our standard ops (PenTest_Playbook_v1.pdf).

Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
